b: The certification recognises the wood products’ performance across five sustainability categories, with manufacturing now powered by 100% renewable electricity.
The redevelopment of Annecy Haute-Savoie Mont-Blanc Airport in France features an Accoya timber facade inspired by its Alpine surroundings (Image: Accsys)

British-based wood products supplier Accsys has announced that Accoya and Accoya Color have achieved Cradle to Cradle Certified Full Scope at Gold level under version 5.0 of the certification standard, making them among the first building products to meet its updated requirements.

The standard assesses products against five sustainability categories: material health; product circularity; clean air and climate protection; water and soil stewardship; and social fairness. It evaluates their performance in areas relating to health, circularity and fairness.

Released in Feb 2026, version 5.0 introduces stricter requirements for renewable energy use, circularity, greenhouse gas emissions reduction, human rights management and water conservation. The certification is recognised by several green building schemes, including LEED and BREEAM.

For architects, specifiers and customers, the achievement provides independently verified information on the products’ sustainability performance. Accoya is also known for its durability and dimensional stability, supporting its use in building applications.

The assessment covered raw materials, environmental performance and manufacturing processes across Accsys’ production sites in Europe and the US. It required detailed data collection, technical documentation and independent verification across all five categories.

To meet the updated requirements, Accoya and Accoya Color are now manufactured using 100% renewable electricity. Accsys has also committed to offsetting 25% of its cradle-to-gate emissions, including those from transport, alongside ongoing efforts to improve manufacturing energy efficiency.
Gillian Edwards, head of ESG at Accsys, said the achievement demonstrated the company’s commitment to sustainability and circularity.

“Cradle to Cradle Certified Gold provides our customers with independent assurance that our products meet demanding standards across material health, circularity, responsible production and environmental and social performance,” she said.
The certification is valid for three years, until Oct 2029.
